/rdzogs pa a ti yo ga ni chos rnams kyi 'bras bu lta bu'o zhes gsungs so/ / gsum pa shes byed rgyud sde'i rnam grangs dgod pa la drug las/ dang po krī ya la'ang spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud gnyis las/ krī ya spyi'i rgyud drug la/ rig sngags thams cad kyi khog dbub pa dpung pa bzang po'i rgyud/ rig sngags thams cad kyi dbang bskur ba phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ rig sngags thams cad kyi gsang ba bstan pa rig pa mchog gi rgyud/ rig sngags thams cad kyi 'dul ba ston pa su siddhi ka ra'i rgyud/ rig sngags thams cad kyi 'phrin las ston pa khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyud/ rig sngags thams cad kyi dgongs pa ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud do/ / bye brag gi rgyud la/ rigs gsum gyi spyan ras gzigs kyi skor la/ padma rtse mo sngags kyi rgyud/ padma cod pan gyi rgyud/ cho ga sngags kyi rgyud/ yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud/ /a mo gha pā sha'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /phyag na rdo rje'i skor la/ phyag na rdo rje dbang gi rgyud/ rdo rje sa 'og gi rgyud/ rdo rje be con gyi rgyud/ rdo rje rnon po'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /'jam dpal gyi skor la/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' dri ma med pa'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal dra ba gcod pa'i rgyud/ bstod pa glur blangs kyi rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /las phran tshegs kyi rgyud la/ gzungs gra nga dang*/ 'od zer can dang*/ sgrol ma dang*/ gtsug tor dang*/ mdzod sbu nor bu la sogs pa gzungs phran rnams so/ /u pa ya la/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud/ me klong 'bar ba'i rgyud/ dbang bskur ba'i rgyud/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /yo ga la/ rdo rje dbyings rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag lnga pa le lag dang bcas pa/ pā shā ka ra rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud/ padmā ka ra dpal mchog dang po'i rgyud/

sa mutstsha rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud de gzhung chen po bzhi/ ngan song sbyong ba dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi rgyud/ dpal mchog bsdus pa de kho na nyid kyi rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /ma hā la rtsa ba'i rgyud dpal gsang ba 'dus pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ ri rab zom rgya mtsho dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ ye shes rgyas pa sa gzhi dang mnyam pa'i rgyud/ sku'i rgyud 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ gsung gi rgyud padma sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ thugs kyi rgyud rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ yon tan gyi rgyud rin chen sgyu 'phrul 'dra ba/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud karma sgyu 'phrul dra ba ste/ 'di dag la le'u 'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis las/ bod du le lag kha cig 'gyur bar 'dod do/ /man ngag gi rgyud la/ bar chad bsrung ba gzi ldan 'bar ba mtshams kyi rgyud/ rngam byed me ltar 'bar ba'i rgyu/ za byed rol pa sbyin sreg gi rgyud/ stobs po che yongs su sgrol ba'i rgyud/ zla gsang nag po'i rgyud/ tshe bdag las kyi gshin rje'i rgyud/ zhi ba lha'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ /a nu la/ mdo sgyu 'phrul ye shes rngam pa glog gi 'khor lo/ phur pa thal byed/ dur khrod khu byug rol pa/ kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo/ dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo/ yi ge rnam dag gi mdo dang mdo drug

/rtsa ba'i rgyud la/ thig leg 'dus pa'i rgyud/ sgyu ma chen po'i rgyud/ zla gsang thig le'i rgyud/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i rgyud do/ /gdams pa man ngag gi rgyud la/ sku'i rgyud me ltar 'bar ba/ gsung gi rgyud dbang chen 'dus pa/ thugs kyi rgyud puṇḍa rī ka/ yon tan gyi rgyud lha mo gsang ba/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud rigs 'dzin 'dus pa/ rig sngags spyi'i sgrub pa he ru ka'i tant+ra/ bye brag gi sgrub pa zla gsang nag po/ padma gsung gi rgyud rta mchog rol pa/ yang dag thugs kyi rgyud he ru ka'i gal po/ phur pa 'phrin las kyi rgyud bi to ta ma la 'bum sde/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi rgyud bdud rtsi rol pa che chung*/ ma mo rbod gtong gi rgyud ma mo kun 'dus so/ /sgrub pa sde drug las kha tshar gyi rgyud la/ 'phrin las thams cad kyi kha skong ba chos nyid gtor ma'i rgyud/ las rgya mtsho ji ltar bya ba karma mā le 'phrin las kyi rgyud/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa tshogs kyi rgyud che chung*/ mchod pa mi zad pa'i gter du byin gyis rlob pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rgyud/ sbyor ba gnas su dag pa thig le klong gi rgyud/ sgrol ba gnas su dag pa stobs po che yongs su sgrol ba'i rgyud/ brtul zhugs drag po'i kun tu sbyod pa glang po che rab 'bog gi rgyud/ las bzhi mthar phyin pa za byed rol pa sbyin sreg gi rgyud/ las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba gtor ma'i rgyud che chung*/ bka'i 'khor lhag mas bskangs nas las la bskul ba dpal 'bar khro mo'i rgyud/ gdug pa can gzir mnan gyis cher bcad pa zhing bcu rol ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'o/ a ti la/ sems nyid bya rtsol las 'das pa nam mkha' che rtsa ba'i rgyud/ de nyid nyams su blang pa nam mkha' che phyi ma'i rgyud/ de nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu nam mkha' che phyi ma'i rgyud yongs su sgrol ba/

sems nyid 'pho 'gyur med pa chos nyid rgyal po'i rgyud/ sems nyid thig le nyag gcig tu ston pa byang chub sems kyi thig le'i rgyud/ sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes su ston pa ye shes thig le'i rgyud/ sems nyid thams cad kyi rtsa bar ston pa man ngag 'phreng ba'i rgyud/ sems nyid kun khyab chen por ston pa gsang ba rgyal po'i rgyud/ sems nyid rang rig tu ston pa ye shes dam pa'i rgyud/ sems nyid kun tu bzang po'i rol par ston pa mkha' dbyings rnam dag gi rgyud/ sems nyid kun gyi snying por ston pa man ngag snying po'i rgyud/ sems nyid rang rig tu yid ches par ston pa snying po gsang ba'i rgyud/ sems nyid kun gyi rtsa bar ston pa nam mkha' che rtsa ba can gyi rgyud/ /sems nyid gcig pur 'dus par ston pa nyag gcig dgongs pa'i rgyud/ sems nyid ji bzhin par bzhag pas ston pa bsam gtan chen po'i rgyud/ sems nyid rgyun chags su goms par ston pa bsam gtan rgyun chags kyi rgyud/ sems nyid thams cad du gsung par ston pa sgo mang mdo'i rgyud/ sems nyid dbang dang sbyar nas ston pa nam mkha' che dbang gi rgyud/ sems nyid sgra tshig las 'das par ston pa nam mkha' che yi ge med pa'i rgyud/ sems nyid gdod ma'i gnas su ston pa nam mkha' che gzhi'i rgyud/ sems nyid 'od gsal du ston pa rin po che 'bar ba'i rgyud/ sems nyid yon tan lhun grub tu ston pa rin po che phreng ba'i rgyud/ sems nyid khams gsum la gsal bar ston pa khams gsum sgron ma'i rgyud/ sems nyid spang blang las 'das par ston pa nges pa snying po'i rgyud/ sems nyid 'pho 'gyur med par ston pa rdo rje gsang ba'i rgyud/ sems nyid ye nas sangs rgyas par ston pa ye sangs rgyas pa'i rgyud de dbyings rtsa ba'i rgyud nyin shu rtsa lnga/ lung bam po bco brgyad gdams pa man ngag gi rgyud la/

thams cad byang chub kyi sems las byung ba rig pa'i khu byug /rtsol sgrub zil gyis gnon pa rtsal chen sprugs pa/ sems nyid dbyings su rdzogs pa khyung chen gshog rdzogs/ chos nyid ye gnas kyi dgongs pa rdo la gser zhun/ sems nyid lhun grub kyi lta ba mi nub rgyal mtshan/ sems nyid ye nas stong pa rmad byung rgyal po/ sems nyid chos skur ston pa ye shes dam pa/ sems nyid thig ler ston pa yang tig rgyal po/ sems nyid skye shi med par ston pa srog gi 'khor lo/ sems nyid 'dod dgu 'byung bar ston pa yid bzhin nor bu/ sems nyid mnyam rdzogs chen por ston pa thig le 'dus pa/ sems nyid theg pa kun rdzogs su ston pa nam mkha' che rgyal po/ sems nyid kun gyi yang rtser ston pa rtse mo phyung rgyal/ sems nyid ye bde spros bral du ston pa bde ba rab 'byams/ sems nyid nyon mongs pa med cing zag med du ston pa bde ba 'phra bkod/ sems nyid 'khor 'das kyi gyes gzhir ston pa gter chen yongs rdzogs sems nyid theg pa kun gyi spyi chings su ston pa lhun grub spyi chings/ sems nyid rgya chad dang phyogs lhung med par ston pa nam mkha' mtha' dbus kyi rgyud do/ bshad pa'i rgyud la/ 'khor ba dong sprug rin po che gsang ba'i rgyud/ byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po/ a ti bkod pa chen po yongs su rdzogs pa'i rgyud la sogs pa spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud sde nam mkha' dang mnyam par bzhugs so/ / spyi don gsum pa de dag la bshad cing nyan pa'i tshul la/ bshad thabs kyi tshul bsam pa/ ji ltar bshad cing nyan pa'i tshul/ bshad cing nyan pa'i phan yon bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po la'ang sangs rgyas chos gsung ba'i tshul/ dgra bcom pa chos gsung ba'i tshul/ paṇḍi ta chos gsung ba'i tshul dang gsum las/ dang po ni cho 'phrul gsum la brten nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad de/

rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul 'od 'gyed pa dang shing ta la bdun srid tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags pa la sogs sku'i cho 'phrul tshad med pa bstan pas gdul bya dad cing 'dun par mdzad nas kun brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gdul bya'i rigs dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal ma lus pa mngon par shes pas gzigs te/ de dang mthun pa'i chos bstan par dgongs nas 'khor gyi rgyud byin gyis rlob par mdzad pa ni thugs kyi cho 'phrul te rgyud dag cing las su rung bar bkod nas/ rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gdul bya'i mos pa bzhin chos kyi char 'bebs par mdzad pas 'gro ba rnams mngon par mtho ba dang nges par legs pa'i go 'phang la sbyor bar mdzad do/ /'di cho 'phrul rnams las mchog tu bshad de/ mdzod las/ cho 'phrul rnams las bstan pa mchog /mi 'khrul phyir dang mthun phyir dang*/ / yid 'ong 'bras la sbyor byed phyir/ /zhes so/ /cho 'phrul gsum gyi 'thad pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyis gdul bya dad par byed de ma dad pa chos kyi snod ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang spyod 'jug las/ ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ /mi na bzhin du mgo g.yogs dang*/ /gdugs dang 'khar ba mtshon thogs dang*/ / mgo bo dkris pa dag la'ang min/ /zhes so/ /kun brjod pas sems las su rung ba dang rgyud so sor mkhyen nas/ rjes su bstan pas mos pa dang skal ba ji lta ba bzhin ston te/ de lta ma yin na chos des gdul bya la phan mi thogs te/ nad dang sman 'dzol ba ltar slar la dug tu 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ / yang spyod 'jug las/ rgya chen chos kyi snod gyur pa/ /dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo las/ rnal 'byor spyod pa stong pa nyid/ /gnas ma yin par sbyar mi bya/ /gnas ma yin par sbyar byas na/ /bdud rtsi dug tu 'gyur ba bzhin/ /zhes so/ /dgra bcom pa chos gsung ba'i tshul ni/ nyan pa po'i snod dag pa/

'chad pa po'i ngag dag pa/ gsung rab kyi brjod bya dag pa dang gsum la brten nas 'chad do/ /'chad pa ni mngon shes kyis brtags pas chos kyi snod yin ma yin shes te/ snod dang ldan pa nyid gdul bya'i yul du byas nas/ ngag dag pa rna bar snyan zhing ngag tshig dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar te/ chos kyi don dag pa nor ba dang 'khrul pa med par thar par 'dren pa'i sgra'i rnam grangs la sogs pa bstan pas don du 'gyur ba'o/ /'o na cho 'phrul gsum la brten nas mi 'chad pa ci yin zhe na/ nyan thos rnams la mi shes pa'i rgyu bzhi yod pas 'chad par mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyu bzhi ni/ yul gyis bskal pas mi shes te/ yul ha cang thag ring drags pa na 'dug pas mi shes pa mauṅgal gyi bus ma gar skyes ma shes pa lta bu'o/ /dus kyis bskal pas mi shes te dus ha cang snga drags pa na nam byung mi shes pa shā ri'i bus khyim bdag dpal skyes kyi thar pa'i sa bon ma shes pa lta bu'o/ /mtshan nyid kyis bskal pas mi shes te/ rgyu thug med kyi 'bras bu ji ltar yin pa dang*/ 'bras bu thug med kyi rgyu ji ltar yin pa la sogs pa ste/ mdo las/ rma bya'i mdongs ni gcig pu la/ /rgyu yi dbye ba tha dad rnams/ /de mkhyen pa ni kun mkhyen te/ /kun mkhyen ye shes min pas min/ /zhes so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rab tu mang po mi shes te/ stobs bcu dang*/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang*/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi la sogs pa byang chub chen po'i chos ma thob pas/ khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po la sogs pa kun nas sgo'i chos kyi rnam grangs blta ba la mi dbang ba'i phyir te/ rgyud bla ma'i 'grel pa las/ mdor bsdu na gang zag bzhi po 'di ni de bzhin bshegs pa'i snying po mthong ba la mig dang mi ldan par rnam par bzhag ste/ bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ so so'i skyi bo dang*/ nyas thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/

theg pa la gsar du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ste zhes so/ /paṇḍi ta chos gsung ba'i tshul la gnyis las/ dpal nā laṇḍa'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i paṇḍi ta rnams ni/ bka' thams cad phun sum mtshogs pa lngas 'chad/ bstan bcos thams cad rtsis mgo yan lag lngas 'chad do/ /phun sum tshogs pa lnga las/ gnas dang*/ ston dang*/ chos dang*/ 'khor dang*/ dus phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /'di dag kyang longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing dang*/ sprul pa'i gnas gyis mngon par 'dus ma byas pa dang/ byas pa gnyis su bstan to/ /longs sku gzhir gnas kyi zhing mngon par 'dus ma byas pa la/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dpal rnam par snang mdzad/ chos phun sum tshogs pa theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig /'khor phun sum tshogs pa sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ dus phun sum mtshogs pa rtag pa rgyun gyi khor mo'o/ /'du byas pa ni bka' 'khor lo gsum gyi rim pas/ 'khor lo dang po la/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa wā rā ṇa sī drang srong lhung ba ri dgas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i nags/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa shākya thub pa chos phun sum tshogs pa bden pa bzhi/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa lnga sde bzang po lha brgyad khri dang bcas pa/ dus phun sum tshogs pa sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag bdun lon pa'i dus so/ 'khor lo bar pa las/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa rgyal po'i khab bya rgod kyi phung po'i ri/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa shākya thub pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa bka' rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sde tshan drug tu gtogs pa/ 'khor phun sum tshogs pa la gnyis las/ thun mong gi 'khor shā ri'i bu dang*/ maudgal gyi bu dang*/ rab 'byor la sogs pa dge slong lnga stong tsam dang skye dgu'i bdag mo la sogs pa dge slong ma lnga brgya tsam dang*/ khyin bdag mgon med zas sbyin dang*/ dge bsnyen ma sa ga ma la sogs pa dge bsnyan dang*/

dge bsnyan ma'i tshogs rab tu mang po rnams so/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong dang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas dang*/ ded dpon dam pa la sogs pa bye ba khrag khrig rab tu mang po rnams so/ /dus phun sum tshogs pa lo bcu gnyis su zla ba gnyis kyis ma chog pa'i bar du gsungs pa'o*/ / 'khor lo tha ma ni*/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa lha'i gnas dang*/ klu'i gnas dang*/ rgyal po'i khab dang*/ grong khyer padma can la sogs pa'o/ /ston pa phun sum tshogs pa shākya thub pa'o/ /chos phun sum tshogs pa nges pa don gyi rnams grangs de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bstan pa la sogs pa'o/ / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i tshogs rab tu mang po rnams so/ /dus phun sum tshogs pa lo sum bcu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du gsungs so/ /rtsis mgo yan lag lnga ni/ mdzad pa po gang gis mdzad pa lung gang nas btus pa/ phyogs gang du gtogs pa/ don ched su'i ched du mdzad pa/ dbu nas zhabs su bsdus pa'i don dus bstan pa dang lnga'o/ /bstan bcos 'di dang bstun na/ mdzad pa po bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'o/ /lung rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang/ 'bras bu gsangs sngags kyi theg pa kun las btus so/ /phyogs rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen por gtogs te blo rim brgyad a tir 'jug pa'i thabs kyi yan lag rdzogs pa chen po'o/ /don ched da lta dang phyi rabs kyi gang zag rim gyis pa dang cig car ba thams cad skyel so mthun par byas pa'o/ /dbu nas zhabs su bsdus pa'i don la gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum dang lta sgom spyod pa gsum ste drug kyang lam du 'jug pa'i thabs dang*/ lam dngos dang*/ mthar phyin pa 'bras bu'i rim pa gsum du bsdus nas ston pa'o/ bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang na bzhugs pa'i panḍi ta chos gsung ba'i tshul la/

nyan pa po snod du rung bar byed pa dang*/ bstan pa'i rnam gzhag nges pa gnyis kyis 'chad do/ /'thad pa ni/ thog mar nyan pa po'i snod khyad par can du bsgrubs nas/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i byung tshul bka' bstan bcos kyi rim pa rnams bstan pas shin tu 'brel chags par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /nyan pa po snod du rung ba'i chos la/ mdzad pa po slob dpon gyi che ba/ des mdzad pa chos kyi che ba/ che ba de lta bu dang ldan pa'i chos de bshad cing mnyan pa'i tshul dang gsum mo/ /'thad pa ni/ slob dpon dang chos kyi che ba brjod pas/ nyan pa po dang rjes 'jug rnams bla ma dang chos la dad mos skye/ des byin rlabs zhugs nas thar pa'i lam dang chos la 'jug pa'i rgyu byed de/ rgya cher rol pa las/ de la dad pa ni chos snang ba'i sgo ste sems las su rung bar byed pa'o zhes pa dang*/ slob dpon klu grub kyi zhal snga nas kyang*/ 'di ltar chos rnams thams cad kyi/ rtsa ba mos pa lags par gsungs*/ /zhes so*/ /bstan bcos 'di dang bstun na/ slob dpon ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la gus pas legs par 'dzin pa/ theg pa chung ngu dang chen pa'i tshul khong du chud pa/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa sde snod gsum dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa rgyud sde bzhi'am drug gi rang bzhin legs par rtog pa/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa'i rim pa la legs par bslab pa/ 'chad pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ rtsom pa'i gnas la dbang 'byor pa*/ lta ba dang rtogs pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dam pas rab tu brgyan pa/ theg pa rgyal po'i khang bzang dam pa na/ rab tu zhi ba'i yang dag 'jog la gnas pa/ snying rjes rang dang gzhan gyi don la brtson pa'i go cha bgos pa ste/ mang du thos pa'i chos smra ba tshul khrims blo gros zhes bya ba'o/ /chos ni theg pa mtha' dag gi snying po'i don phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i gzhung lam ma nor ba/

dbang po'i rim pa thams cad gong du 'khrid pa/ lam gyi cha lag gzhan la mi ltos pa/ thos pa'i ma rig pa'i mun pa sangs ba/ bsam pa'i gnas lugs kyi dgongs pa rtogs pa/ bsgoms pas chos nyid kyi klong du grol ba/ bshad pas rang gzhan gyi shes rab 'phel ba/ nyan pas blo gros kyi padmo rgyas pa/ bltas pas nyon mongs kyi sdig sgrib 'dzad pa/ dpyad pas thar lam gyi byang chub brnyes pa ste/ yon tan dpag tu med pa'i tshogs chen pos legs par brgyan pa'i gang chen mtsho/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi bstan bcos ngal gso skor gsum zhes bya ba yin no/ /ji ltar bshad cing mnyan pa'i tshul ni/ chos smra ba la sman pa mkhas pa'i 'du shes/ chos la sman gyi 'du shes/ bdag nyid la nad pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas gus pas nyan te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu/ khyod kyis bdag nyid la nad pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /chos la sman gyi 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gshen la sman pa'i rgyal po'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /nan tan nyams su len pa la nad nyer bar 'tsho ba'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o zhes so/ /rgyas par 'og tu 'chad do/ /bstan pa'i rnam gzhag nges pa la/ dang po ston pas 'khor lo gsum ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ bar du dgra bcom pa rnams kyis ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul/ tha mar bstan bcos mkhan po rnams kyis bstan bcos ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul dang gsum gyis 'chad de gong du bshad pa bzhin no/ / 'di dag ni bshad tshul nges pa'i tshig go / gnyis pa ji ltar bshad cing nyan pa'i tshul la gsum ste/ 'chad pa po slob dpon gyi rang bzhin/ nyan pa po slob ma'i rang bzhin/ thun mong du bya ba'i rang bzhin no/ /dang po ni mdo sde'i rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan brtson byas lhag par lung gis phyug /rtogs dka'i de nyid rab tu smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la

bsten/ /zhes pa ltar/ sku gsung thugs zhi zhing legs par bsdams pa/ yon tan dang brtson 'grus che ba/ thos pa che ba las khyad par du lung gi gnas la mkhas pa/ zab mo'i don ston pa la mkhas shing snying rje che ba/ chos ston pa la dka' ba bzod pa ste de lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa ni chos dang bla ma la gus shing don gnyer gyi 'dun pa khyad par can yod pas chos la bsgrub par nus pa ste/ slob dpon shākya 'od kyi zhal snga nas/ bla ma la gus tshul khrims yongs dag dang*/ /bsam gtan dang ni 'don la rtag brtson dang*/ /grims shing dul la bzod dang ldan pa ste/ / sdom brtson gnas pa'i chos ldan legs par gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ / des kyang snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug dang bral bar byas te nyan par bya'o/ / skyon gsum ni snod kha sbub ltar tshig don la rna ba mi gtad pas cung zad kyang mi 'dzin pa dang*/ zhabs rdol ltar bzung yang nan tan mthar chags su mi byed pas rtogs pa mi brtan pa dang*/ dug can lta bu zin yang nges 'byung gi blo dang sems bskyed kyis ma zin pas nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por mi 'gro bar grogs su 'gro ba rnams spangs te nyan pa ni/ mdo las/ dgeslong dag / legs par rab tu nyon la yid la zung zhig dang*/ ngas khyod la bstan par bya'o zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /legs par nyan pas ni dug can gyi skyon sel ba'o/ /rab tu nyan pas ni kha sbub kyi skyon sel lo/ /yid la gzung bas ni zhabs rdol gyi skyon sel lo/ /dri ma drug ni rnam bshad rig pa las*/ nga rgyal dang ni ma dad dang*/ /don du gnyer ba med nyid dang*/ /phyi rol rnam g.yeng nang du sdud/ /skyo bas nyan pa dri ma yin/ /zhes so*/ /chos nyan dus che khyad kyi nga rgyal dang sgeg 'chos stan ches mtho bar sdod pa la sogs dang/ chos dang/ grogs dang bla ma la ma dad bzhin du nyan pa dang*/ chos la don gnyer 'dod 'dun med pa dang*/

mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ yid la sogs pa'i dbang po phyi'i yul la 'phyo 'jug pa dang*/ gnyid rmugs la sogs pa'i sems nang du bsdus pa dang*/ chos 'dis ci bya snyam pa la sogs pa chos la bar du gcod pa'i skyo ba rnams spangs la nyan no/ /de yang dga' ba dang*/ gus pa dang*/ dad pa bskyed nas/ gnyid rmugs la sogs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ nga rgyal la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams spang la/ tshe 'di'i blau ngan dri ma can las 'das pa thar pa kho na la dmigs pas/ sems can gyi don du ngas chos 'di nyan la rgyud la phan pa zhig bya snyam du mos pa dang 'dun pa khyad par can dung dung ba bskyed nas nyan pas thos pa dri ma med pa'i gzi brjid du 'gyur ro/ /'di gal po che yin te chos lam du 'gro ba yang dang po'i sgo thos pa byed dus nas ma 'chugs pa zhig dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'phags pa yon tan rin po che yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ dga' dang gus dang dad pa'i mchog ni nyer gzhag ste/ /sgrib pa nyon mongs bsal nas dri ma las 'das pa/ /'gro don mngon zhugs nges pa'i shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gang la dpal rnams spyod pa 'di ni mnyan par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ / gsum pa thun mong du bya ba'i rang bzhin la gsum las/ sbyor ba sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub thob par bya/ de'i ched du chos nyan snyam du sems bskyed nas/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos ston pa po de thub pa 'khor rnams la 'khor rnam bzhi so sor shes pas nyan no/ /sngags la dkyil 'khor gcig tu shes pas gtso 'khor gsal btab nas nyan no/ /yang na slob dpon 'jam dpal du bsam pa'i zhal nas chos kyi 'od zer 'phros pas slob ma sgrol mar bsam pa'i rna ba na tshur thim par bsam pa'o/ /'dir ni rang nyid gang mos su bya'o/ /dngos gzhi ni 'chad pa po dang nyan pa po gnyis ka chos kyi tshig don la 'jal ba'i ngang las ma yengs par sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin pa'o/

/rjes la dge ba sems can gyi don du bsngos nas mi rtag pa dang rmi lam sgyu ma tsam du shes pa'i chos dang ston pa'i bka' drin rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de ltar bshad cing nyan pas pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshang ba ni/ chos kyi stan dang mchod pa bshams pa ni sbyin pa/ sgo gsum bsdams nas nyan pa ni tshul khrims/ de dus shig la sogs pa'i 'tshe ba bzod pa ni bzod pa/ bla ma la chos gsung bar bskul ba brtson 'grus*/ ma yengs par nyan pa bsam gtan/ the tshom gyi gnas rnams bsgal brtag gis 'dri ba shes rab ste/ chos spyod thams cad kyi man ngag mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud las*/ me tog stan sogs rab 'bul ba/ /sa phyogs spyod lam bsdams pa dang*/ /srog chags kunal 'tshe mi byed/ bla ma la ni gsol ba 'debs/ /ma yengs bla ma'i gdams ngag 'dzin/ rtags la phyir la skyon tshig 'dri/ /sgrol ma yan lag drug dang ldan/ /zhes gsungs so*/ /zhal la slob dpon gyi drug kyang*/ legs par smra ba sbyin pa ste/ /nyon mongs bsdams pa tshul khrims nyid/ /skyo bar bzod pa bzod pa ste/ /'chad la btson pa brtson 'grus nyid/ /de las ma yengs bsam gtan la/ /tshig don 'byed mkhan shes rab nyid/ /'jam dpal yan lag drug dang ldan/ /zhes bya ba ni bsdu ba'i tshig su bcad pa'o/ / gsum pa bshad cing nyan pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ de ltar yang dag pa'i chos la gang gi bshad pa na/ sbyin pa rnams kyi nang nas chos kyi sbyin pa mchog tu 'phags pa'i phan yon 'thob ste/ tshe rabs thams cad du chos kyi mdzod 'dzin pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pas dgongs par 'gyur ba dang*/ rtag tu tshe rabs dran pa dang*/ sangs rgyas las chos thos par 'gyur ba dang*/ myur du sangs rgyas 'thob pa la sogs pa'o/ /nyan pas ni sems kyi sgrib pa sbyong ba dang*/ the tshom gyi 'ching ba gcod pa dang*/ rtag tu dam pa'i chos dang mi 'bral ba dang*/

chos kyi gzungs 'thob pa dang*/ ngan 'gro log par ltung bar mi 'gyur ba dang*/ lhas bsrung zhing nad dang 'tshe ba nyung ba dang*/ myur du sangs rgyas 'thob pa la sogs te shes rab kyis mig rnyed pas 'khor ba las 'da' bar 'gyur te/ rgyud bla ma las*/ gang phyir 'di ni shes rab mchog yin de yi rgyu ni thos pa yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ sdud pa las*/ shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes nas/ khams gsum ma lus pa las myu ra du 'da' bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /de dag gis chos byung ba'i tshul spyir bshad pa gtan la phab zin to/ / spyi don gnyis pa skabs kyi don bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ spyi chings lngas 'brel dgod pa dang*/ dgos 'brel yan lag bzhis gtan la dbab par bya ba'o/ /dang po ni rnam bshad rig pa las/ mdo don smra bar 'dod rnams la/ /man ngag cung zhig sbyin par bya/ /de la man ngag 'a di yin te/ /dgos pa bsdus pa'i don bcas dang*/ /brgal lan bcas dang mtshams sbyor bcas/ /tshig don bcas te bsnyad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa dang sbyar te/ bstan bcos 'dir don lngas nye bar mtshon pa/ dang po dgos pa'i don ni/ ngal gso skor gsum 'grel pa dang bcas pa nye bar bkod pas/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag gis thos pa dang bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa'i rim pa bde blag tu rtogs te zhugs pas/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don gnyis 'grub pa'i thabs dam par gyur pa ni 'di'idagos pa'o/ /de la bsten nas thar pa'i lugs gsal ba dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i sgo'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'jig rten na dar zhing rgyas pa ste mchog gi dgos pa khyad par can yang yod do/ /bsdus pa'i don ni/ gzhi lta ba dang lam sgom pa dang*/ grogs spyod pa gsum tshang la ma nor bar ston pa yin no zhes bya ba bsdus so/ /tshig gi don ni/ gzhung rgya cher bshad pa'i skabs bzhin no/

/snga phyi 'brel pa'i 'tshams sbyor ni/ dang por gang zag gcig lam du 'jug pa na chos kyi gzhi 'cha' ba gal che bas de'i phyir sems nyid ngal gso le'u bcu gsum gyi rang bzhin du/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba nas bzung ste lta ba mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i gzhi rnams rgya cher bstan nas/ cha shas lam dang 'bras bu'i rim pa'ang 'phros pa'i tshul du yang bshad pa yin no/ /de ltar gzhi rtogs nas lam bsgom pa la 'jug pas/ bsam gtan ngal gso le'u bzhi pas rang bzhin du*/ gang du bsgrub pa'i gnas dang*/ gang gis bsgrub pa'i gang zag dang*/ gang ltar bsgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ gang bsgrub pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnams go rims kyis legs par bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar lam bsgrub pa na chos thams cad la ma chags pa dang zhen pa med pa 'ba' zhig gtso bor ston dgos pas/ de'i grogs su spyod pa'i rim pa rgya cher gsal ba'i gnas sgyu ma ngal gso le'u brgyad kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma'i dpe brgyad du chos thams cad ji ltar spyad cing nyams su blang ba'i rim pa tshang la ma nor bar bstan pa yin no/ /rgal lan gyis gtan la dbab pa la gsum las/ dang po sems nyid ngal gso la brgal ba/ ci khyed kyi bstan bcos 'di nyid sems nyid ngal gso zhes brjod pa mi 'thad de/ sems nyid la ngal gso ba dang thang chad pa gnyis char med pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /de yis lan bshad pa/ spyir sems nyid ces pa'i sgra 'di nges gzung dang gzhi bsdu ba gang du yang sbyar du rung bas/ nges bzung ltar na sems nyid ngal gso dgos te/ sems dang sems las byung ba thams cad 'khor ba'i rgyu khams gsum pa'i sgro btags kyi rnam par rtog pa yin pas/ de nyid rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyings su nye bar zhi dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bden gnyis las/ sems dang sems byung khams gsum pa/ /sgro btags rnam pa can rtog yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba dang*/

/byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /zhes pa dang*/ 'jug pa las/ sems 'gags pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad/ /ces dang*/ phyogs kyi glang pos 'jam dpal la bstod pa las*/ rnam rtogs ma rig chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ / rnam rtogs de dang bral bas na/ khyod ni rtag tu mya ngan 'das/ /zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas ngo sprod pa rin po che gsang ba'i rgyud las kyang*/ kye gsang ba'i bdag po/sems dang sems las byung ba thams cad ni 'khor ba'i chos yin no zhes ngas bstan te zhes gsungs so/ /des na sems dang sems byung gi rtog pa de nyid kyi rang bzhin 'khor bar yang dang yang du dub cing ngal bar byas pas/ da ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes chos kyidabyings shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i ngal stegs la ngal gso ba bya'o/ /de'i ched du gnas lugs kyi bgrod lam de kho na nyid du 'jug cing ngal gso ba'i bstan bcos 'di brtsam par bya zhes kho bo cag gis dam bcas nas bstan pa yin te/ nyi khri snang ba'i mjug dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel chung du/ kye ma gzhungs lugs sna tshogs kyis/ /dub pa dag gis ngal gso'i gnas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i lugs/ /ring mo zhig nas mthongs ba yis/ /zhes gsung pa dang mthun no/ /gzhi bsdu ba dang sbyar na yang sems nyid ngal gso bar 'thad de/ sems 'phrul snang la ring du spyad cing 'khor bas dub pa'i mgron po kun tu rtog pa'i tshogs dag

/sems nyid ngal gso ba'i bsti gnas spros pa zhi ba'i ngang du ma bcos par 'jog pa yin te/ mgron po chad cing dub pa dag ngal stegs la rang babs su glod nas lus ngag yid gsum dal bar 'jog ste ngal gso ba bzhin no/ /de'i phyir ngal gso ba sems nyid du/ sgo gsum 'khor bas dub pa'i sems kyi spros pa rang zhir ngal gso ba 'di thar pa dam pa'i 'jugs ngogs te/ tog rtse bas/ dub pa sems nyid kyi mgron po dag /spros dang bral bar ngal sos shig /so ma gnyug ma rang babs dang*/ /blo 'das phyag rgya chen po yin/ /zhes pa dang/ skye med rin po che'i mdzod las/ gar yang ma rtog cir yang ma bsams shig /bcas cos ma byed rang bzhin lhug par zhog /ma bcos pa de skye med rin chen mdzod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gshegs shul yin/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /bsam gtan ngal gso la brgal ba ni/ ci khyed kyi bstan bcos 'di bsam gtan ngal gso zhes brjod pa mi 'thad de/ bsam gtan rang bzhin gyis mi rtog pa la ngal dub gang yang med pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /de'i lan la gnyis las/ nges gzung dang sbyar ba ni/ bsam gtan ngal gso zhes brjod pa 'thad de/ 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan rtog med rang gsal gyi ting nge 'dzin khams gsum pa'i sems kyi spyod yul can 'di dag kyang 'khor zhing dub pa'i mgron po lam 'khyams nas dub pa lta bu yin pas/ de thar pa dam pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsam gtan gyi ngal stegs shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin zung 'brel khyad par can gyi zhi lhag tu sgom pas 'da' dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan de dag shes rab khyad par can gyis ma zin pas lam du mi 'gyur te/ zhi lhag zung 'brel khyad par can gyi ting nge 'dzin ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgo'i bsam gtan khyad par can sgribs pa'i gnyen po byed pa/ 'khor bar las nges par 'byin pa'i lam mchog tu ngal gso ba yin

no/ /bshes spring las/ bsam gtan med pa la yang shes rab med/ /shes rab med pa la yang bsam gtan med/ /gang la gnyis po yod pa 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho gnag rjes lta bur 'tshal bar bgyi*/ /zhes pa bzhin no/ /gzhi bsdu ba dang sbyar na/ bsam gtan ngal gso zhes 'thad de/ yang dag pa'i bsam gtan spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa de nyid 'khor bar dub pa'i sems kyi mgron po rnams kyi ngal gso'i bsti gnas khyad par yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de yang yul dngos po gzugs sogs su snang ba la gzung ba'i rtog pa yang med de yul can dngos med sems kyi rang bzhin la 'dzin pa'i rtog pa yang med par/ blo dmigs pa med pa de ni ngal gso khyad par can gyi gnas yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /de tshe rnam par gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /sgyu ma ngal gso la brgal ba ni/ ci khyed kyi bstan bcos 'di sgyu ma ngal gso zhes mi 'thad de/ sgyu ma ni rang bzhin gyis med pa'i phyir de la ngal ba dang gso ba med pa'i phyir ro zhes so/ /lan la gnyis las/ nges gzung dang sbyar ba ni/ sgyu ma ngal gso zhes 'thad de/ 'khor ba kun tu rtog pa'i sgyu ma 'di dag la ngo bo med kyang rnam pa snang cha ma 'gags pas/ snang cha sgyu ma'i mgron po dag lam du ngal gso ba ltar med bzhin snang ba'i sems kyi sgyu ma nyid/ chos nyid yang dag pa'i ngang du ngal gso ba snang dgos te/ snang tsam du 'khoraba'i sdug bsngal las grol zhing 'da' dgos pa'i phyir ro/ de'ang 'khor ba sgyu ma'i ngo bo nyid du shes nas yang dag sgyu ma'i dbyings su snang la rang bzhin med par spyad pa'i grol ba yin te/ lang kar gshegs pa las/ srid gsum 'di dag sgyu ma dang*/ /smig rgyu chu yi phung po bzhin/ /nor bar mthong bas phyir bzlog go /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/

/gzhi bsdu ba'i la ni/ sgyu ma ngal gso zhes 'thad de/ yang dag sgyu ma'i ngo bo nyid de/ log rtog sgyu ma'i ngal stegs kyi gzhi khyad par can yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang sems nyid rang bzhin gyis dag cing 'od gsal ba de nyid yang dag sgyu ma yin la/ de'i rang bzhin bdag gzhan spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du/ log rtog sgyu ma 'khrul snang 'khrul rtog dang bcas pa rten med gzhi med chen por ngal gso ba yin te/ gsang snying las/ yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /bdag dang bdag gi gzhan med de/ /bdag dang gzhan dang rtog pa'i rgyun/ /log par rtog pa tsam nyid las/ /phra zhing zab pa'ang yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /de'i bya ba chos thams cad sgyu ma'i rang bzhin du snang bas/ ngal gso ba dang dub par snang ba ma 'gags la/ snang ba'i dus nas yong ma myong bar kho bo 'dod do/ /'phags pa ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji ltar skye bo mang po'i dbus dag tu/ /sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te/ /rta dngaglang po shing rta sna tshogs byas/ /de nyid mi bden snang ba sna tshogs ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ / zhes pa dang*/ ji ltar sgyu mar gyur pa'i gzugs/ /skyes pa ma yin 'ongs pa min/ /de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kun/ /skyes pa ma yin 'ongs pa min/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa dgos 'brel yan lag bzhis gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ spyir ngag tsam la yod pa'i dgos 'brel yan lag bzhi dper 'god/ dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos 'brel yan lag bzhis bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i rgyur brjod/ bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos 'brel yan lag bzhis gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni spyir skyes bu rtogs ldan gyi ngag tsam la dgos 'brel bzhi tshang du rung ste/ dper na bum pa khur la chu lon zhes pa'i ngag de'i brjod bya ni chu'o/ /dgos pa ni ngag de la brten nas chu khyim du thob pa'o/

/nying dgos ni chu des skom pa bsal ba la sogs pa skyes bu'i don grub pa'o/ /de gsum yang gcig med na gcig mi 'byung yod na 'byung ba'i phan tshun 'brel ba ni 'brel pa'o/ / gnyis pa bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos 'brel rnams 'di'i brjod bya'o/ /de la bsten nas bstan bcos la chos bzhi tshang bar rtogs pa ni dgos 'brel gyi ngag bkod pa'i dgos pa'o/ /de la bsten nas rtogs ldan gyi gang zag bstan bcos 'dir 'jug pa de nying dgos so/ /de gsum gcig la gcig 'brel du med na mi 'byung yod na 'byung bar grub pa ni 'brel pa'o/ / gsum pa ni gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas gsal bar byed pa ngal gso skor gsum gyi tshig dang don gyi rim pas gang zag gcig gi thar lam tshang la ma nor bar ston pa'i tshul ni brjod bya'o/ /de ltar yod pa de skyes bus rtogs pa ni dgos pa'o/ /rtogs pa bzhin nyams su blangs pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don gnyis 'grub pa ni nying dgos so/ /de gsum gcig la gcig 'brel du yod na 'byung med na mi 'byung ba ni 'brel pa'o/ / de dag kyang 'dul ba'i rgya cher 'grel par/ de bas na 'dul ba'i mdo la brjod par bya ba med pa dogs pa bsal ba'i phyir brjod par bya ba bsnyad do/ /'bras bu med par dogs pa bzlog pa'i phyir dgos pa brjod do/ / thabs med par dogs pa spang ba'i phyir 'brel pa bshad do/ /'dod pa'i don grub par bya ba'i phyir dgos pa'i dgos pa yang bstan to zhes rgya cher gsungs pa bzhin no/ / spyi don gnyis pa bshad bya gzhung gi don dngos rgya cher bstan pa la gsum ste/ chos thams cad gzhung lam gcig tu ston pa rdzogs pa chen po sems nyid ngal gso 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya cher bshad pa/ chos thams cad 'od gsal lhun grub chen por ston pa rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya cher bshad pa/

chos thams cad bden med rang snang du ston pa rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya cher bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ 'grel pa bshad pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu brjod pa/ 'jug yul lus kyi don rgya cher bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ dang po la mtshan gyi don/ phyag gis mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po la mtshan bsgyur ba/ bshad pa/ gang la mtshan du gsol ba dang gsum las/ bsgyur ba ni legs par sbyar ba'i skad dang ldan pa/ rgya gar skad du ma hā sandhi la sogs pa 'di dag /bod skad du bsgyur na/ ma hā chen po/ sandhi rdzogs pa/ tsittā sems/ ta la ring cha byin pa'i khong nas shuddha zhes 'byung ba de kho na nyid du dag pa sbyor ba ste/ sgra bsgrubs pas sems nyid bcas pa'o/ /bi sran ngal gso/ bṛtti 'grel pa/ ka thī shing*/ gho rta rta/ nā ma zhes bya ba'o/ /bshad pa ni/ rdzogs pa 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad do/ /gang du rdzogs na chen po rang byungagi ye shes su ye nas tshang zhing de las chos thams cad 'byung ba ste/ kun byed las/ gcig rdzogs gnyis rdzogs sems su rdzogs/ /bya ba phun sum tshogs pas bde/ / zhes pa dang*/ do ha las/ sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ / yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so/ /sems nyid ni nges par gzungab dang sbyar na sems dngasems byung ngo*/ /ngal gso ni rang byung gi ye shes su spros pa dang bral bar ston pa'o/ /gzhi bsdu ba dang sbyar na/ sems nyid ni rangabazhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o/ /ngal gso ni kun tu rtog pa cha dngabacas pa 'jug pa zhi bar ston pa'o/ /'grel pa la tshig 'grel/ don 'grel/ 'byed 'grel/ rgya cher 'grel/ dga' 'grel/ sgrung 'grel dang drug las/ 'di rgya cher 'grel lo/ /shing rta ni gzugs can gyi rgyan du shan sbyar ba ste/

shing rta gsum gyis me'i 'obs las byis pa 'dren pa'i dpe dam pa'i chos padma dkar por gsungs pa ltar/ 'dir bla na med pa'i thegs pa'i shing rtar skal ba chen po rnams 'dren pas/ thar ba'i gling du phyin par byed pa dang*/ yang gcig tu na ngal gso skor gsum la tshig don gyi gnas gsum yod pa las/ 'dir zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gnas thams cad rdzogs par ston pas kyang shing rta chen po'o zhes bya ba ni/ tshig gi phrad 'og ma dang 'tshams sbyor bas bkod mdzes par byas pa tsam mo/ /gang la mtshan du btags pa ni sems nyid ngal gso zhes pa don la mtshan du btags la/ shing rta chen po zhes pa dpe la mtshan du btags pa'o/ / gnyis pa phyag gis mchod par brjod pa la gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyaga'atshal lo zhes pas/ dpal ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes so/ /kun tu bzang po ni zab cing rgya che ba'i yon tan dpag tu med pas kun nas brgyan pas gzhan don 'phro ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal ba ni sgo gsum gus pas 'bul ba ste/ rnam 'grel du/ rtogs pa'i dra ba rnam bsal cing*/ /zab cing rgya che'i sku mnga' ba/ /kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer dag /kun nas 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /rgyas par bshad pa la gsum las/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal ba ni dpal ldan tshogs gnyis la sogs pa ste char sprin bzang po dang chos mtshungs par bstod pa gzugs can gyi rgyan no/ /padma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ o rgyan mtsho gling la sogs pa ste yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis bstod pa dang*/ shis pa brjod pa'i rgyan te/ bsres pas rab spel gyi rgyan dang gsum du 'gyur ro/ /rang byung ye shes la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gdod nas 'od gsal la sogs pa ste sems nyid la yod pa'i gshis kyi rang bzhin brjod pa rigs rang bzhin brjod pa dang*/ zab cing rgya che ba'i gnas brjod pas rgya che ba dang phul byung gnyis bsres pas rab spel gyi rgyan rnams kyis bsngags pa'o/

/brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ dus gsum rgyal bas zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ sangs rgya sa kyis sngon byon pa'i lam der rang gzhan thams cad bgrod nas thar pa thob par bya ba'i phyir bstan bcos brtsam par bya'o zhes dam bcas nas brtson pas go bgo ba ste/ brgyad stong 'grel chen du/ gzhan don brtse ba can rnams srog phyir yang*/ /rang gi nus pa lhod par mi byed de/ /skyes bu dam pa khur lci khur ba dang*/ /nyam nga'i gnas su nam lang 'dor mi byed/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin no/ /'jug yul lus kyi don dang*/ yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don ni 'grel pa dang bsdus don gyi gnas ji lta ba bzhin no/ / spyi don gnyis pa chos thams cad 'od gsal lhun grub chen por ston pa rdzogs pa chen po bsam gtan ngal gso 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya cher bshad pa la gsum ste/ 'grel pa bshad pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu brjod pa/ 'jug yul lus kyi don rgya cher bshad pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan gyi don/ phyag gis mchod par brjod pa/ brtsamasas par dam bca' ba'o/ dang po la/ mtshan bsgyur ba/ bshad pa/ gang la mtshan du gsal ba dang gsum las/ bsgyur ba ni skad rigs chen po bzhi dang ldan pa'i yul rgya gar gyi skad du/ ma hā sandhi la sogs pa 'di dag bod kyi skad su bsgyur na/ ma hā ni chen po/ sandhi rdzogs pa/ dhya na bsam gtan/ shuddha don 'gyur du ngal gso ste sgra 'gyur du dag pa zhes 'byung ba de nyid gnas lugs dang*/ngal gso dang*/chos nyid gsum la 'jug pa las 'dir ngal gsor bsgyur te/ gnas lugs dang chos nyid de nyid ngal gso khyad par can yin te/ 'khor bar dub pa dag don de bsgoms pas ngal sos pa ste dbugs 'byin pa'i phyir ro/ /bṛtti 'grel pa/ bi shuddha rnam dag / ka thī shing*/ ghorta rta/ nā ma zhes bya ba'o/ bshad pa ni/ rdzogs pa chos thams cad/ gang du rdzogs na rang byung gi ye shes chen po la tshur rdzogs pas 'khor 'das thog ma'i ka dag rang rig ngo las gzhan du ma grub/

phar rdzogs pas chos thams cad rtsa ba rig pa las gyes pa'i phyir/ phar rdzogs tshur rdzogs thig le nyag gcig gi klong du rdzogs pa'o/ /rdzogs pa rig pa'i yin pa'i chen por bzhag ste/ chos gzhan gyi klong yin pa'i phyir ro/ /kun byed las/ klong chen sems kyi yul de na/ /mi gnas pa ni gcig kyang med/ /ces so/ / gsam gtan ni gnas lugs kyi ngang gdangs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rtse gcig las gzhan du ma yengs par gnas pa ste/ sangs rgyas sras gcig gi rgyug las/ sems dal bsam gtan ngang gis rnyed/ /ces pa bzhin no/ / ngal gso ni chos nyid kyi ngang dang 'dres dus sems rnam rtog gi mgron po 'phro 'du med par rang babs chos zad chen por dbugs phyin pa'i don te/ mgron po dub pa bsti gnas su cha babs glod nas bzhag pa'i ngal gso ba bzhin no/ /'grel pa ni rtsa ba'i don gsal ba ston/ rgyas par ston/ go ba byed ces bya ba ste sngar bzhin no/ /shing rta ni mgron po 'dod pa'i gnas su 'dren pa'i bzhon pa 'khor lo yang mig dang bcas pa lta bu ste/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer du skal pa mchog dang ldan pa'i skye bo 'dren pa'i bzhon pa yin pas so/ /sdud par/ de gang zhon nas sems can thams cad mya ngan zlo/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /rnam dag ni nyes pa'i skyon med pa dang/ chos nyid byang chub sems su chos thams cad dag par ston pa dang*/ dag mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i lam dam pa yin pa'i phyir rnam par dag pa ste/ mtshan brjod las/ 'di ni rnam dag legs pa'i lam/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /zhes bya ba ni tshig gi phrad de/ don snga phyi 'brel par ston pa'i ngag go /gang la mtshan du btags pa la/ bsam gtan ngal gso ni don gyi cha nas btags/ shing rta rnam dag ni dpe don tshogs pa la btags pa'o/ / phyag la gnyis las/ mdor bstan ni sngar bstan pa bzhin no/ /gzhi dang sbyar na/ dpal ni rang byung gi ye shes/

kun tu ni dus gsum thams cad du 'pho 'gyur med par sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dgongs pa bzang po las mi g.yo ba ste phyag 'tshal ba ni don de rtogs par bya'o zhes pa'o/ / lam dang sbyar na/ dpal ni rig pa byang chub kyi sems cog gzhag chos sku'i dgongs pa'o/ /kun tu ni dus rtag par de'i ngang las mi 'da' bar byed pa'o/ /bzang po ni chos sku'i ngang las ma 'das na snang sems thams cad ye grol rdzogs pa chen po'i rol par shar ba'o/ /phyag 'tshal lo ni sgom pa chos nyid kyi klong du phebs par bya ba la brtson par bya zhes pa'o/ /'bras bu dang sbyar na/ dpal ni thog ma'i mgon po ste 'khor 'das kun gyi bla mar byon pas lhun grub rin po che gsang ba'i sbubs na nang gsal sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med par bzhugs pa'o/ /kun tu ni de'i ngang nas stug po bkod par nges pa lnga ldan gyi bkod pa ston pa'o/ /bzang po ni de'i ngang las thugs rje chen pos 'gro drug so so'i gnas su thub pa drug gi rol pas 'dul ba'o/ / phyag 'tshal ba ni gus pas 'bul ba ste/ gsang snying las/ ye shes dbyings las mi gzhan phyir/ /thugs rje chen pos 'brel bas na/ /'gro drug dus gnas ma lus snang*/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /phyag rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gang gi rang bzhin la sogs pa ste nam mkha' la nyi ma shar ba dang sbyar nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' la bsngags pa ni gzugs can gyi rgyan no/ /brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ skal bzang la sogs pa ste/ bya ba rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis bstan bcos kyi don 'grol bar khas blangs ba'o/ /'jug yul lus kyi don dang yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don ni 'grel pa dang bsdus don gyi gnas bzhin no/ / spyi don gsum pa chos thams cad bden med rang snang du ston pa rdzogs pa chen po sgyu ma ngal gso 'grel pa dang bcas pa rgya cher bshad pa la gsum ste/

'grel pa bshad pa la 'jug pa'i rgyu brjod pa/ 'jug yul lus kyi don rgya cher bshad pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshan gyi don/ phyag gis mchod par brjod pa/ brtsam par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po la/ mtshan bsgyur ba/ bshad pa/ gang la mtshan du btags pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni 'phags pa'i yul dbus 'gyur 'chang*/ rgya gar skad du/ ma yā la sogs pa/ bod skad du bsgyur na/ mā yā sgyu ma/ shuddha ngal gso/ /bṛtti 'grel pa/ thī shing/ gho rta rta/ nā ma zhes bya ba'o/ /bshad pa ni/ sgyu ma ni bden med kyi chos te/ ma dag pa 'khor ba'i sgyu ma mgron po thang chad pa lta bu dang*/ dag pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgyu ma dbyings 'od gsal gyi bden pa bsti gnas bzang po lta bu gnyis te/ gsang snying las/ yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul gnyis su/ /zhes so/ /ngal gso ni mthar thug ka dag dang/ gnas skabs chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i bsti gnas bzang po der blo rang mal du gnas pa'i don to/ /'grel pa dang shing rta ni sngar bzhin no/ / bzang po ni mchog dam pa phul du gyur pa'o zhes bya ba ni mtshams sbyor ba ste/ mtshan de lta bu dang gzhung don gnyis don gcig par ston pa/ bum pa zhes pa dang lto ldir gnyis gcig par ston pa bzhin no/ /gang la mtshan du btags pa ni/ sgyu ma ngal gso don dang*/ shing rta bzang po dpe don tshogs pa la btags pa'o/ phyag la gnyis las/ mdor bstan pa ni/ dpal rda rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pas/ dpal ni longs sku nges pa lnga ldan/ rdo rje ni sku 'pho 'gyur med pa/ sems dpa' ni sprul sku ma nges sna tshogs te/ sku gsum byang chub mchog gi go 'phangs brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang po thog mtha' med pa'i ston pa la/ phyag 'tshal lo gus pas 'bul ba'o/ ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/

/rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*/ /phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la'o/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /phyag rgyas par bshad pa ni/ gdod nas byang chub la sogs pa ste/ yon tan rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gyis bla ma dang sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bsngags pa'o/ brtsam par dam bca' ba ni/ gdul bya'i khams dang la sogs pa ste/ yon tan dang rdzas rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan gnyis rab spel gyi rgyan du bkod pa'i gzhan don du rtsa ba'i don 'grel par dam bcas ba'o/ /dgos pa ni/ mtshan bkod pas bstan bcos btsal sla ba dang rgya bod don mthun par shes la/ phyag 'tshal bas rtsom pa mthar phyin pa dang/ gzhan rjes su zhugs pa'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang/ ston pa la dad cing bstan bcos la 'jug par 'dod pa'i 'dun pa bskyed pa ste/ slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas/ bstan bcos byed pas ston pa la/ /mchod par brjod pa 'bras med men/ /ston pa dang ni bstan bcos la/ /dad 'dun bskyed par bya phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin no/ /rtsom par dam bcas pas mthar phyin par 'gyur ba la/ bar skabs su skyo ba dang bya dka' ba la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis mi 'phrogs par byed pas/ khas blangs pa dang dam bcas pa dag nyam 'og tu chud par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /skye bu dam pa khur lci khur ba dang*/ /nyam nga'i gnas su nam yang 'dor mi byed/ / ces bshad pa bzhin no/ / gnyis pa 'jug yul lus kyi don dang/ yongs su rdzogs pa mjug gi don ni 'grel pa dang bsdus don gyi skabs bzhin no/ /'di dag gi tshe don gyi 'brel dgod pa sbal ba'i 'phar stangs dang/ tshig gi 'bru gzhol ba rus sbal gyi nur 'gros dang/ skabs kyi don bsdu ba glang po che'i 'gying lta bu dang gsum gyis bcings nas bshad pa ni 'chad pa'i man ngag me tog gi 'phreng ba lta bu sbyin pa'o/ /de ltar bshad thabs yan lag nges pa'i don/

/zab cing rgya che don gsal yid du 'ong*/ /theg mchog dam pa rab tu mdzes byed pa/ / me tog phreng ba ma brnyings gsal bar spel/ /thos pa'i sprin chen rab tu bzang po las/ /legs bshad 'brug sgra phyogs kyi mthar khyab pa/ /tshig don rnam bkra'i glog gi phreng ba can/ /gzhan don byed pa mtha' yas char chen 'bebs/ /'di ni dpal ldan dga' ba'i skyed mos tshal/ /thos bsam ting 'dzin me tog rgyun chags pa/ /nyer bkra'i rang bzhin 'gro kun ngal gso'i gnas/ /byang chub lam bzang gsal bar byed pa la/ /tshul 'di theg mchog snying po'i rnal 'byor pa/ /blo dang thos pa'i 'dab stong rgyas pa des/ / gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas su bkod/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /dam chos rin chen shing rta mchog zhugs te/ /'khor ba'i mya ngam thang las rab brgal nas/ /thar pa'i grong du dga' ston 'phel bar shog /bde gshegs bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog
